title: Lifting the head while face down by about 2 months
summary: Most children hold their head up when on their tummy by about 2 months.
body: Face down on a tummy, the nape does the work of lifting. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention 2-month movement line names that lift: holds head up when on tummy. The page treats it as something most children do by two months. Doing the lift later is not a label this card applies. Ages on lists from outside the United States can be printed differently. Prone chin-lift off the rug is precisely this two-month movement item. Prone chin clearance during tummy time is exactly the cited two-month item.

sources.title: Milestones by 2 Months
